headline: AI Earnings Boost Market, Hyperscaler Capex Surges, Fed Holds Rates
summary: US indices closed higher, driven by strong AI-related earnings from tech giants. The Federal Reserve maintained current interest rates, though inflation concerns persisted. Hyperscalers announced substantial increases in capital expenditure for AI infrastructure.

bullets.lead: AI chip demand continues to drive growth across the semiconductor supply chain.

segments.text: Lam Research raised its WFE outlook, citing AI as a key driver for NAND, DRAM, and advanced packaging demand.

sources.title: Lam Research raises WFE outlook as AI drives NAND, DRAM, advanced packaging demand

segments.text: Advantest also lifted its fiscal 2026 forecast, anticipating surging demand for AI chip testing.

sources.title: Advantest lifts fiscal 2026 forecast as AI chip test demand surges

bullets.lead: Advanced packaging technologies are seeing significant investment and expansion.

segments.text: TSMC is developing new AI chip packaging technology, aiming to counter Intel's advancements in the space.

sources.title: TSMC Develops AI Chip Packaging Tech to Counter Intel

segments.text: Lam Research increased its 2026 advanced-packaging growth expectation to over 70%, driven by HBM, 2.5D/3D integration, and leading-edge foundry logic.

bullets.lead: Major hyperscalers are significantly increasing their capital expenditure for AI infrastructure.

segments.text: Amazon lifted its capex plan after strong cloud sales, with AWS revenue growth accelerating sharply to 37% in Q2.

sources.title: Amazon lifts capex plan after strong cloud sales; shares jump

segments.text: Meta Platforms reported $279 billion in future data center leases for AI and raised its FY2026 capex range to $130B-$145B, despite an EPS miss due to higher AI and legal costs.

sources.title: Meta Reports $279 Billion in Future Data Center Leases for AI

bullets.lead: xAI is planning a massive datacenter buildout, facing potential power constraints.

segments.text: xAI has ordered compute for an 8GW datacenter buildout by YE2027, though supply-side analysis suggests only 3.5-5GW is feasible due to bottlenecks in power generation.

bullets.lead: The Federal Reserve maintained its current interest rates amidst persistent inflation concerns.

segments.text: The Fed held the federal funds target at 3.50%-3.75% with a hawkish 9-3 vote, as three regional presidents dissented for an immediate 25bp hike, noting solid economic activity.

sources.title: Fed interest-rate decision rocks Wall Street's inflation fears

segments.text: The U.S. economy slowed to a 1.5% growth rate in Q2, while June core inflation registered at 3.3%.

bullets.lead: Other companies provided varied guidance, reflecting sector-specific challenges.

x_themes.topic: Meta Platforms (META) Q2 Earnings & Capex Hike
x_themes.summary: Meta reported Q2 revenue beat but EPS miss due to higher AI and legal costs, leading to a raised FY2026 capex range of $130B-$145B. The market reacted negatively to the increased spending and EPS miss.

x_themes.topic: Microsoft (MSFT) Q4 Earnings & Azure AI Growth
x_themes.summary: Microsoft reported strong Q4 earnings with revenue and EPS beating expectations, driven by 43% Azure revenue growth and over 30 million paid Copilot seats. The company did not raise capex guidance, which was positively received.

x_themes.topic: Lam Research (LRCX) Q4 Earnings & Broadening WFE Cycle
x_themes.summary: Lam Research's Q4 earnings call signaled a materially positive semiconductor capital-equipment cycle, with AI-related investment broadening beyond leading-edge logic and HBM into conventional DRAM, enterprise NAND, and advanced packaging, raising the CY26 WFE outlook to the low-$150B range.

x_themes.topic: Meta Platforms (META) AI Infrastructure & Supply Chain Impact
x_themes.summary: Meta's Q2 earnings call validated commercial returns from AI while confirming a more capital-intensive infrastructure phase, with strong demand for AI accelerators, HBM, advanced-node foundry capacity, networking, optical connectivity, and power/cooling systems.

x_themes.topic: Korean Memory Market Rout & Forced Deleveraging
x_themes.summary: The KOSPI experienced back-to-back circuit breakers, with SK Hynix dropping significantly despite strong earnings, driven by mechanical selling and forced deleveraging in single-stock leveraged ETFs, leading to a severe memory market rout.

x_themes.topic: FOMC Decision: Rates Held with Hawkish Dissent
x_themes.summary: The Fed held the federal funds target at 3.50%-3.75% with a hawkish 9-3 vote, where three regional presidents dissented for an immediate 25bp hike, noting solid economic activity despite elevated uncertainty and inflation above 2%.

x_themes.topic: US Senators warn Apple on Chinese Memory Chips (CXMT, YMTC)
x_themes.summary: US Senators urged Apple to abandon talks with Chinese memory chipmakers CXMT and YMTC, citing national security concerns due to their presence on Pentagon lists, amidst a global memory shortage.

xAI has ordered compute for an 8GW datacenter buildout by YE2027, but supply-side analysis indicates only 3.5-5GW is feasible due to bottlenecks in power generation and environmental permitting, despite chips and transmission being non-issues.

x_themes.topic: Advanced Packaging Growth Outpacing Front-End WFE
x_themes.summary: Lam Research increased its 2026 advanced-packaging growth expectation to over 70%, driven by HBM, 2.5D/3D integration, and leading-edge foundry logic. Amkor Technology also reported strong computing revenue growth from new datacenter CPU packaging programs.

Lumentum's optical capacity is up eightfold in 2.5 years but remains sold out, indicating strong demand for high-power lasers. The company also secured a long-term agreement for InP substrates from AXT Inc. with a $43.5M deposit.

x_themes.topic: DRAM Capital Intensity Broadening Beyond HBM
x_themes.summary: Lam Research reported that DRAM represented 23% of its June-quarter systems revenue, with spending broadening beyond HBM packaging into conventional front-end DRAM, which is increasingly adopting process requirements associated with leading-edge foundry logic and 3D NAND.

x_themes.topic: AI-Driven Enterprise Storage as NAND Demand Vector
x_themes.summary: Lam Research's NAND revenue more than doubled sequentially, attributed to conversions toward 256-layer-and-above NAND devices primarily supporting enterprise SSDs, explicitly linking expanding AI context windows to stronger flash-storage demand.

x_themes.topic: Taiwanese AI Server Makers Expand Capacity
x_themes.summary: Three major Taiwanese AI server manufacturers—Quanta, Wistron, and Inventec—are expanding their production capacity through plant acquisitions and land purchases in Taiwan, California, Texas, and Thailand to meet surging demand.

x_themes.topic: US CHIPS Act funding for GlobalFoundries (GFS) CPO/Silicon Photonics R&D
x_themes.summary: The US government will take a 1% stake in GlobalFoundries and award $300M via the CHIPS Act to accelerate domestic CPO and Silicon Photonics R&D, signaling strong support for these technologies and benefiting partners like Sivers and Lumentum.
